description: This file contains tests and sample FastAPI application code demonstrating various request parameter and body schema customizations using pydantic models and FastAPI decorators.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model with schema_extra for custom JSON schema examples.

methods.name: create_app()
methods.description: Creates a FastAPI instance with endpoints that demonstrate request body and parameter examples.

methods.name: test_call_api()
methods.description: Tests various endpoints by making POST and GET requests to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema()
methods.description: Fetches the OpenAPI schema and verifies that example overrides are correctly included.

methods.name: cookie_example( data: Union[str, None] = Cookie( default=None, example="cookie1", ), )
cookie_example_examples( data: Union[str, None] = Cookie( default=None, example="cookie_overridden", examples=["cookie1", "cookie2"], ), )
cookie_examples( data: Union[str, None] = Cookie( default=None, examples=["cookie1", "cookie2"], ), )
example(item: Item = Body(example={"data": "Data in Body example"}))
example_examples( item: Item = Body( example={"data": "Overridden example"}, examples=[ {"data": "examples example_examples 1"}, {"data": "examples example_examples 2"}, ], ), )
examples( item: Item = Body( examples=[ {"data": "Data in Body examples, example1"}, {"data": "Data in Body examples, example2"}, ], ), )
header_example( data: Union[str, None] = Header( default=None, example="header1", ), )
header_example_examples( data: Union[str, None] = Header( default=None, example="header_overridden", examples=["header1", "header2"], ), )
header_examples( data: Union[str, None] = Header( default=None, examples=[ "header1", "header2", ], ), )
path_example_examples( item_id: str = Path( example="item_overridden", examples=["item_1", "item_2"], ), )
query_example( data: Union[str, None] = Query( default=None, example="query1", ), )
query_example_examples( data: Union[str, None] = Query( default=None, example="query_overridden", examples=["query1", "query2"], ), )
query_examples( data: Union[str, None] = Query( default=None, examples=["query1", "query2"], ), )
